# La Grande Armee

**Version 1.0** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3806598359) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=grande-armee&expanded=true)

Napoleon arrives in 867. Everyone else is about nine hundred years behind.

This is not another invincible stack. It is a **military revolution**, handed
to you centuries before anyone should have it — and then allowed to spread.

---

## Proclaim the Military Revolution

One click teaches your culture gunpowder, standing armies, the royal armory,
plate armour and sapping.

Here is the part that makes it interesting: those innovations are granted to
your **culture**, not to you. The base game spreads innovations between
neighbouring cultures, so they will get out. Introduce gunpowder in the ninth
century and your rivals will have muskets eventually.

**Your advantage is a head start of decades, not a monopoly.** That is the
actual Napoleon story — he did not win because he was invincible, he won because
the whole way of making war changed and everyone else was fifteen years behind.
Then they caught up.

## The Doctrine

Teach a character the **Grande Armée Doctrine** and they learn to fight the
modern way: corps that march apart and concentrate at the decisive moment, a
professional army paid out of the treasury rather than owed by oath, and
artillery massed until walls become a scheduling problem.

The doctrine is also the key to the arsenal. Only a character who holds it can
raise the regiments.

## Five regiments

| Regiment | Role |
|---|---|
| **Infanterie de Ligne** | Massed volley fire. Poor in wetlands and forest, as it should be. |
| **La Vieille Garde** | The Old Guard. Held back until it matters, then decisive. |
| **Cuirassiers** | Shock cavalry. Devastating on open plains, useless in the mountains. |
| **Foot Artillery** | The grand battery. Fights in the line and flattens walls. |
| **Horse Artillery** | Guns that keep pace with cavalry — the real Napoleonic innovation. |

## They are bought, not summoned

The regiments appear in your men-at-arms screen. They cost gold, they count
against your cap, and they are expensive to keep — twice what heavy cavalry
costs. You build the Grande Armée over decades and you pay for it every month.

That is the point. A standing professional army is exactly the thing feudal
realms could not afford, and it should feel like a commitment rather than a
cheat code.

## Strong, not untouchable

For scale: the average men-at-arms in Crusader Kings does around 30 damage. The
best troops the medieval world can field — gendarmes, cataphracts — reach 125.
The Grande Armée sits between 130 and 175.

It will carve through any feudal host you point it at. It is not invincible, and
a large enough coalition that has caught up on innovations can still bury it.
You have to actually use it well.

## Things to know

- **Works on anyone.** Teach the doctrine to yourself, an heir, a favourite
  vassal or an ally — so the Grande Armée can outlive its founder.
- **The AI never uses any of this.** It only reaches the wider world through
  normal innovation spread.
- **Fully reversible.** The doctrine can be unlearned. Regiments already
  raised will remain.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.19 "Scribe"**.
- **Ironman and achievements:** this mod will disable achievements.
- **Other mods:** it adds one trait, five men-at-arms types and five
  interactions, and overwrites no base game file.
- **Existing saves:** safe to add mid-game. Disband the regiments before
  removing the mod.

## Languages

Available in all nine languages the game supports. English is fully written; the
other eight currently show the English wording. Translations are welcome.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `grande-armee-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=grande-armee&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
